description: Custom objectives (migrations/038) attached to the mission. obj-a has no faction restriction and awards both VP and Campaign Points. obj-b is restricted to the player's own faction (empire) and is achieved, so its VP counts. obj-c is restricted to a different faction (orcs) — even though it's ticked in customAchieved (e.g. a stale checkbox from before the mission/faction changed), it must NOT contribute, proving the faction-eligibility check is re-applied here rather than trusting customAchieved blindly.
